definitions.short: Peleth , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H6431. Peleth מֶּ֫לֶת proper name, masculine 1. Reubenite Num 16:1 , Φαλεθ[κ] ; read probably מַּלּוּא (q. v.) so Gf Dr and others 2 Judahite 1Chr 2:33 : Θαλεθ, Φαλεθ[ατ] .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to flee ; swiftness ;

occurrences.englishText: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.
The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
